name: login
description: Open 12306 login and wait until the browser session is authenticated

args.name: timeout
args.help: Maximum seconds to wait for the user to finish login

name: read
description: Read a DEV.to article body by id

args.name: id
args.help: DEV.to article id (numeric, e.g. 3605688)

args.name: max-length
args.help: Max characters of body to return (min 100)

args.name: limit
args.help: Number of memos to fetch (1-200)

args.name: since
args.help: Only memos updated after this Unix timestamp in seconds

args.name: slug
args.help: Pagination cursor from a previous memo page

args.name: limit
args.help: Number of stories

name: bookmarks
description: Fetch your Twitter/X bookmarks (the logged-in user's saved tweets, newest first)

args.name: limit
args.help: Maximum number of bookmarks to return (default 20). Ignored when --all is set.

args.name: all
args.help: Fetch all bookmark pages until exhausted. Prefer --output-file for large archives.

args.name: resume-file
args.help: Resume file for long-running all-pages bookmark syncs.

args.name: output-file
args.help: Write all-page results to JSONL. Requires --all and --resume-file.

args.name: max-pages
args.help: Optional pagination safety cap (default 100; raised automatically with --all).

args.name: top-by-engagement
args.help: When set to N>0, re-rank the bookmarks by weighted engagement (likes×1 + retweets×3 + replies×2 + bookmarks×5 + log10(views+1)×0.5) and return the top N. Default 0 keeps the API's native (saved-time) ordering. Incompatible with --output-file.

args.name: id
args.help: Topic ID

name: publish
description: 小红书发布图文笔记 (creator center UI automation)

args.name: content
args.help: 笔记正文

args.name: title
args.help: 笔记标题 (最多20字)

args.name: images
args.help: 图片路径，逗号分隔，最多9张 (jpg/png/gif/webp)

args.name: card-text
args.help: 文字配图卡片文字，多张卡片用 ||| 分隔，卡内换行用 \n

args.name: card-style
args.help: 文字配图卡片样式，运行时按页面实际选项匹配；找不到会失败。省略时使用基础。可选: 基础(默认兜底，万能) 边框(金句/要点卡) 备忘(提醒/随手记) 清新(日常/清单贴士) 涂写(随笔/碎碎念) 便签(笔记/提醒) 光影(情绪/文艺) 涂鸦(趣味/童话) 简约(干货/观点) 手写(日记/情感) 插图(生活方式/轻松话题) 美漫(活力/趣味/故事感) 弥散(弥散光氛围) 柔和(柔和/温柔金句) 印刷(印刷海报/排版) 科技(科技/产品) 贺卡(节日祝福) 札记(艺术/水彩氛围) 书摘(书摘/引用) 手帐(手帐拼贴) 几何(醒目/有力主张)

args.name: topics
args.help: 话题标签，逗号分隔，不含 # 号

args.name: draft
args.help: 保存为草稿，不直接发布
